name: Solo Brands Inc.
summary: Solo Brands, Inc. operates as a direct-to-consumer enterprise, offering a wide array of outdoor and lifestyle merchandise throughout the United States. Its diverse product portfolio includes camp stoves under the Solo Stove Lite name and fire pits from the Solo Stove brand. The company also provides kayaks through its Oru brand and paddleboards via the ISLE brand. Furthermore, Solo Brands, Inc. supplies storage solutions for fire pits, firewood, and other related accessories. For apparel, its Chubbies brand features swimwear, casual shorts, athletic wear, polos, shirts, and loungewear. Complementing its main product lines, the company also sells consumables such as color packs, starters, natural charcoal, fuel, pellets, and firewood products, along with various accessories, under the Solo Stove, Oru, and ISLE brands. Solo Brands, Inc. was established in 2011 and is headquartered in Grapevine, Texas.
